extra.summary: A great travel credit card with unlimited 2% cashback on Travel, Overseas Spending and Online Spend in Foreign Currencies. You can also enjoy complimentary lounge access with no annual fee!

our_takes.our-take: The CIMB Visa Infinite card offers unlimited cashback – 2% on overseas, online (foreign currency), and travel spend, and 1% on everything else – appealing to frequent travellers. A S$2,000 monthly minimum spend is required, so it's best for consistent, higher spenders. Cashback expires monthly, demanding active tracking. Though travel insurance and lounge access add value, the real draw is the uncapped cashback, particularly for those who frequently transact in foreign currencies. Consider if your spending habits align with the S$2,000 minimum to maximize rewards, otherwise, the cashback is forfeited.
our_takes.good-for:
Affluent individuals seeking unlimited cashback on overseas and online spending in foreign currencies, perfect for frequent international transactions.
Those who enjoy complimentary travel insurance and airport lounge access, enhancing comfort and security during their journeys.
High-income earners aiming to maximize cashback rewards on travel and other retail expenditures exceeding the minimum spend requirement.
our_takes.things-to-note:
S$2,000 minimum monthly spend is required; failing to meet it forfeits cashback earnings.
Cashback expires monthly, so remember to redeem rewards to avoid losing them.
27.8% annual interest rate applies; paying balances in full avoids hefty interest charges.
